title: Emotion-to-Behavior Pathway Explorer
description: Students explain how a triggering situation leads to an emotion, and how that emotion can lead to two different possible behaviors depending on whether the emotion is managed.
creator: Health Education
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Health Education

learningObjectives: Students explain how a triggering situation leads to an emotion, and how that emotion can lead to two different possible behaviors depending on whether the emotion is managed.

pedagogical.instructionalRationale: Supports a Understand-level objective through direct interaction rather than passive reading.
